recentItems.title: Stars Type Out Their Favorite Words Of Wisdom
recentItems.description:
A favorite line. A life lesson. A few words worth remembering. Reece Feldman invites guests at the 17th Governors Awards to leave their mark on Academy history, one keystroke at a time. 

Featuring:

Glenn Close
Himesh Patel
Hoyeon (Jung Ho-yeon)
P.J. Byrne
Guitarricadelafuente
Floyd Norman
Curry Barker
Christine Vachon & Pamela Koffler
Travis Knight
Léa Seydoux
Andrew Garfield
Xochitl Gomez
Monica Barbaro
Skyler Gisondo
John Leguizamo
Inde Navarrette
Isabel May
Jacob Tremblay
Jaafar Jackson
Jack O'Connell
Sebastian Stan
Jordan Firstman

The Academy presented Honorary Oscars to actor Glenn Close, animator Floyd Norman and director Ridley Scott, and the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award to producers Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler, at the 17th Governors Awards on Sunday, November 15, 2026, at the Ray Dolby Ballroom at Ovation Hollywood.
